flawed_step: Lines 0037–0038 incorrectly use meet preservation to assert φ(∨₁A)=∧₂φ[A]. A frame homomorphism preserves joins, so the right-hand side should be ∨₂φ[A].
counterexample: Let L₁=L₂ be the two-element frame {0<1}, let φ be the identity, and hence S₃={0,1}. Take A={0,1}. Then φ(∨₁A)=φ(1)=1, whereas ∧₂φ[A]=∧{0,1}=0. Thus the equality claimed at line 0037 is false.
assessment_summary: The displayed calculation establishing arbitrary-join preservation contains a concretely false equality, so this proof is invalid.
